summary: Ordinary auto/root dev code releases no longer run paper_bootstrap, treat its skip as a failure, or retire an uncreated run-scoped paper case. One job-level decision PAPER_BOOTSTRAP_REQUESTED (auto/root AND any of ppl_alloc_009_dev_proof_enabled, run_loop_prod_tel_002_probe, run_evolution_dispatch_probe, run_bounded_source_refresh, bootstrap_empty_host) gates the paper step, deploy_compensation, lease_cleanup complete_success, the inline compensation retirement, and (via job output paper_bootstrap_requested) the cross-job retirement. Requested paper failure/cancel still blocks admission and compensates.
hosted_operations: none; no SSH, provider or hosted request from the source worker. Root owns the subsequent matching FULL release and readbacks.
